<template>
 <v-row justify="center" >
  <v-col cols="8">
   
  </v-col>
 </v-row>
 

<v-container>
  <v-card-title class="text--primary titulo-login">Dados pessoais</v-card-title>
</v-container>

</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'DashboardView',
  data() {
    return {
      value: false
    }
  },
  methods: {
    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('AUTH_TOKEN');
      this.$router.push(this.$route.query.redirect || '/login');
    }
  }
}

</script>
